claim: a union of two coaxial cylinders whose top caps are coplanar (a 0.6 bore and a 1.05 socket ending together at z = 6.3, the stepped bore of a pipe fitting) commits with the stepped solid's exact volume pi*(0.36*15.6 + 1.1025*3.3 - 0.36*3.3) = 25.3408717; OCCT's fuse of the same operands gives 25.3408715 and reads the export back valid. On r1n and earlier it was refused with K1 reason 92: the caps sit at -9.3 + 15.6 = 6.299999999999999 and 3 + 3.3 = 6.3, one ulp apart, so the exact coplanar test found no pair while the classifier, within its tolerance band, placed each cap on the other solid
